category_title: Gifted student with impulse control disorder and depression exhibiting perfectionism and anger fits
minimal_context: The student is sitting on the floor by a coffee table, drawing a picture of his family.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here is the paper on the coffee table. You can start drawing the picture of you and your family now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: But I am not going to sit on the chair, I am going to sit on the floor. (Bends over the coffee table and starts drawing, then begins erasing and redrawing the same spot over and over) The fences of the animal shelters are not good enough.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It looks fine. We need to finish drawing soon.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Continues etching out minute details on the paper) I am not finished yet.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You have to finish drawing now so we can move on.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Raises head in a burst of anger) My time! My time lost in vain! (Starts shouting inside the classroom, throws his prize chocolates, and then sits on the floor crying, having a fit)
